sections.Profile:
"Mercury" and "Rocket" are two electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in 1950, both sharing identical playfield layouts and artwork. Designed by Harvey Heiss, these machines feature two flippers, a single pop bumper, and ten kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, Travel, Women, Dual Theme, Wood Rail, Space, Beach, Rockets, Water
